title: A repair an organization asks of a node, repair-request/1 (DEC-0101)
description: Carried in a check-in response's records.repairs, signed like a policy layer by a key of the organization's current policy key set (policySigningInput, FAC-SEM-046). The node runs it only as repairDecision answers (FAC-SEM-129). docs/specification/node-summary.md#repairs.

id.description: The repair's id; the node runs it at most once and keeps one repair-result/1 for it, repeated unchanged for a redelivered request.

digest.description: The fabric-package/1 digest; the node runs only a package whose digest the policy's repair.packages lists.

task.description: One line the person reads before it runs: what is repaired. Never a path, a command or a secret.

expiresAt.description: After issuedAt, at most 7 days after it (FAC-SEM-129).

value.description: 64 bytes, base64: an Ed25519 signature, or an ES256 signature as R ‖ S.
